name: Welcome to the Yokai Inn
source:
A quest to save your father whisks you away to the doorstep of Sankiya Inn, the most famous ryokan in the yokai world. There, you broker a deal with the handsome oni owner to work in exchange for room and board, and soon find yourself training under a friendly bakeneko coworker and mingling with otherworldly guests, including a mysterious ronin…

While searching for clues, the four of you uncover startling information about your ancestry… as well as a legendary, terrifying dragon involved in your father's disappearance. Can you and your newfound allies destroy this ancient evil, or will Sankiya meet its end?

Set off on a grand romantic adventure in a world where Japanese folklore comes alive. Pick up the sword to defend your new home and take charge of your destiny!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.spiritryokan]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
为了拯救你的父亲，你来到了妖怪界最著名的日式旅馆三喜屋旅馆的门口。在那里，你与英俊的鬼老板达成协议，以工作换取食宿，很快你就会发现自己在一位友好的巴克内科同事的指导下接受训练，并与超凡脱俗的客人交往，其中包括一位神秘的浪人……

在寻找线索的过程中，你们四人发现了有关你们祖先的惊人信息……以及一条与你们父亲失踪有关的传说中的可怕龙。你和你的新盟友能否消灭这个古老的邪恶，或者桑基亚会迎来它的终结吗？

在充满日本民间传说的世界中展开一场盛大的浪漫冒险。拿起利剑保卫你的新家园，主宰你的命运！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.spiritryokan]Google Play[/url]]
